subtitle.name: Subtitle extension
subtitle.description: Off by default. Words you add with + in video subtitles (Subtitle browser extension) become cards in a deck, with the line, its translation, a screenshot and the audio. Only this computer can connect, with an access key you create here.

default_deck.label: Deck for Subtitle cards
default_deck.description: Deck id that captures go to when the extension names none. Empty: a deck called Subtitle, made on first use. Easier to choose on the Subtitle page.

default_deck.set: Choose the deck for Subtitle cards

validation.subtitle_capture: This word from the Subtitle extension is not valid.
validation.subtitle_media: Only JPEG screenshots and WAV audio clips can be uploaded.

conflict.subtitle_key_state: This access key is already revoked.
conflict.subtitle_note_type: The Subtitle card note type is missing or in the trash. Restore it to receive words again.

subtitle.heading: Subtitle
subtitle.intro: Words you add with + in video subtitles (Subtitle browser extension) become cards here, with the line, its translation, a screenshot and the audio.

connect.title: Connect the extension
connect.description: Works while this app is open. Only this computer can connect.
connect.address_hint: Paste this as the server address in the extension.
connect.step1: Create an access key below and copy it.
connect.step2: In the extension open Ayarlar → Öğrenme servisi (Settings → Learning service), pick Subtitle Kartları and paste the server address and the key.
connect.step3: Click Bağlantıyı test et (Test connection). From then on every word you add with + arrives here.

keys.title: Access keys
keys.description: One key per browser. Revoke a key when you no longer use it: it stops working at once.
keys.name: Key name
keys.new_body: Copy it now and paste it into the extension. It is shown only this once: the app keeps only a fingerprint of it.

deck.title: Where cards go
deck.description: Captures go to the deck chosen in the extension; otherwise here.
deck.label: Deck
